CLAUDE   ~/.claude.json is GENERATED, not copied — two keys, no host bytes
         hasCompletedOnboarding  skips the theme picker, whose answer could not
                    persist anyway (~/.claude/settings.json is not bound from
                    the host here — it is a file on the ~/.claude tmpfs, so it
                    is writable inside and dies with this session)
         autoUpdates=false       the binary is a read-only bind; a self-update
                    inside can only fail
         trust      NOT pre-answered — your host ~/.claude.json does not
                    record this exact path as trusted:
                    projects."/home/u/proj/sub"
                    is absent, and so is the whole projects key, so Claude
                    Code asks "Quick safety check" for it once per run —
                    the prompt that stops a repository's own
                    .claude/settings.json hooks running at startup
         not here   the host file's 62 KB: every project path on this machine,
                    org, email, account UUIDs, machine ID, MCP servers, and the
                    host's per-project tool approvals — so tools you approved on
                    the host are asked again in here
